verbatim_locators.note: Coverage of this pass: Results and the Methods subsection on dataset integration, plus the supplementary captions, read for two questions (does the postnatal periventricular object exist and what bounds it; is any accession named). Figures, supplementary files and most of the Methods NOT read. 🔴 MEASURED HERE, FIRST-HAND: the string 'WWOX' occurs ZERO times in this artefact (case-sensitive count over the whole XML, 2026-09-27) — which bounds PRESENCE IN THE TEXT only, never expression: a per-nucleus zero at bulk-level abundance needs a matched-abundance dropout control, and a caption-level absence is not a measurement.

entries.proposition: The postnatal periventricular microdissection this candidate turns on is a SINGLE two-week-old donor, sequenced by snRNA-seq.
entries.snippet: we microdissected this region from a two-week-old sample and performed single-nucleus RNA sequencing
entries.anchor: Results, 'The EC stream contains migrating interneurons'

entries.proposition: A radial-glia cluster was captured in that postnatal object, distinct from differentiated astrocytes: the compartment is real and postnatal.
entries.snippet: our snRNA-seq of the stream captured a cluster that expressed RG markers
entries.anchor: Results, 'The EC stream is produced by CGE progenitors'

entries.proposition: The authors' own negative blocks the onward reading: no intermediate progenitors for interneurons and no trajectory from the local radial glia to the immature inhibitory neurons were found. A WWOX measurement here would be 'WWOX in postnatal human periventricular radial glia', never 'WWOX in the progenitor supplying the stream'.
entries.snippet: we did not find intermediate progenitors for interneurons or a differentiation trajectory connecting the local RG to the immature inhibitory neurons
entries.anchor: Results, 'The EC stream is produced by CGE progenitors'

entries.proposition: The merged object's postnatal entorhinal arm is an AGE SERIES from 14 days to 27 years, so the achievable scope of a reanalysis is wider than the single periventricular donor; the periventricular microdissection itself stays n = 1.
entries.snippet: nuclei from the postnatal EC between 14 days and 27
entries.anchor: Results, 'The postnatal EC stream supplies LAMP5+ neurons', Fig. 4a,b paragraph

entries.proposition: The data-availability statement in the served body is a bare deferral to the publisher DOI: no accession is named anywhere in it.
entries.snippet: statements of data and code availability are available at

entries.proposition: The paper's only GEO mention names a PREVIOUS study's adult-EC dataset that was re-used, not this study's deposit — the mis-attribution trap a future reanalysis would fall into.
entries.snippet: retrieved from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) from a previous study from the adult EC
entries.anchor: Methods, 'Read alignment, quality control and integration with adult EC dataset'

entries.proposition: An accession-free route exists: the supplementary differential-expression tables are free files, and a WWOX row in them would be a presence statement. Caption verified verbatim in the served markup.
entries.snippet: DE genes in EC stream dataset. Results of a differential gene-expression test (Wilcoxon rank sum) in the dataset containing the EC stream microdissection.
